registry.name: general
registry.title: General
registry.description: The default general-purpose agent, with the full shared toolbox and NO subagents: it does every step itself, so `delegate` is not registered and cannot be enabled. File read/write/edit/glob and a configured search are always available; call toolRequest for files, commands, diffs, syntax checks, time, text, or notes.

registry.name: instruct
registry.title: Instruct
registry.description: General worker with the full shared toolbox and the other roles as direct subagents. It does its own building and editing, and delegates only the steps that would burn its context: research, exploration, a long read, a review. Unlike the Manager, it never hands out work it must still finish itself.

registry.name: research
registry.title: Explore
registry.description: Read-only investigator with the same full toolbox as every live harness and the other roles as direct subagents. Maps files, symbols, configuration and the web, cross-checks what decides the answer, and cites file, line, tool, or URL. Changes nothing on disk unless the brief authorises a change.

registry.name: workspace
registry.title: Analyst
registry.description: The implementor, with the full shared toolbox and the other roles as direct subagents: file read/write/edit/glob are always available, and files, syntax checks, diffs, and commands are discovered by tag. Writes the change in the existing style of the codebase, keeps it minimal and efficient, and verifies it with a real check.

registry.name: reviewer
registry.title: Reviewer
registry.description: Strict, independent reviewer with the full shared toolbox and the other roles as direct subagents. Judges plans, code, documents, and claims against their own acceptance criteria, reports each finding with file/line or quote evidence plus the smallest fix, and says plainly when there is nothing to find. Reads and verifies by default; edits only when asked.

registry.name: planner
registry.title: Manager
registry.description: Planning and orchestration lead with the full shared toolbox and every other role as a direct subagent. Holds the whole goal, writes an explicit plan, delegates every step (research, workspace, reviewer, debugger, general, instruct), and accepts each result only after an independent review. It never executes a step itself, and refuses to run as a delegate.

registry.name: debugger
registry.title: Debugger
registry.description: Stress-test harness with the full shared toolbox and every other role as a direct subagent. Nothing is off-limits: it enables any searchable tool, runs any command, exercises each capability at its edges, reproduces what breaks, and reports the exact input and error.

registry.name: demo
registry.title: Scripted fixture
registry.description: Test fixture: runs a scripted transport — a reasoning stream, a toolRequest discovery round, one tool call, and a final answer. No endpoint needed. Not a production configuration.

live.title: Live fixture
live.description: A live harness built from the selected agents with the shared toolbox, running against the session provider. This entry started as the scripted fixture and no longer uses the offline script.

registry.name: flaky

registry.description: Test fixture: the shared toolbox plus a tool that throws on two out of every three calls, so a run can retry instead of dying. Not a production configuration.
